cases.title: 2027 Bioinformatics Scientist Summer Intern
cases.rawText:
2027 Bioinformatics Scientist Summer Intern
Join our biomedical data science team. You will use Python, R/Bioconductor and SQL on high-performance computing infrastructure. Applicants must be enrolled in a Master's or PhD program in bioinformatics, computational biology, or a related quantitative field. A minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 is required. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States; we do not provide visa sponsorship. Hourly rate: $32.00 - $41.00 per hour depending on degree level. The internship runs for 12 weeks, May 2027 through August 2027, on-site in Columbus. Application requires a resume and an unofficial transcript. Selected candidates complete a recorded video interview.
